answer: The atlas multiplier is published, charged in violet, and zenith lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 10 for each member already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival pays the most. A burst of registrations thus prices itself out, because the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. A farm of 4704 identities would post 921 proofs and burn roughly 26 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
